scope: Proposition C.1 of the manuscript “Entropy and Face Dimension of the Perfect-Matching Polytope” (preprints/Entropy-and-Face-Dimension-of-the-Perfect-Matching-Polytope-September-23-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 113 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 c0b726a089502900), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 42. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There is one deterministic algorithm which, given a graph on n vertices with nonnegative binary integer pair and singleton-loop multiplicities, returns a nonnegative rational number Aloop such that Nloop 218n ≤ Aloop ≤ Nloop. It returns zero exactly when Nloop = 0. Its running time and output length are polynomial in the input bit length, including when the input gives n in binary and lists only the positive pair and loop records.
